text:
Dmitry Maryanov died in October 2017 at the age of 47. The cause of the death of the star of the movie “Rainbow” is a broken thrombosis. The artist was buried at the cemetery of Khackinsky.
The widow of the first actor Ksenia Bik after the tragedy with Maryanov was modest, the artist did not leave a rich heir. Ksenia even had to interview about her husband in many different programs with a good fee.
With his daughter, Anfisa from his first marriage, Bik often goes to the next cake. There, she met journalist Sergei Sobolev, who became the new husband of Ksenia. But in recent years, Widow's life Maryanova has changed suddenly. BIC has become a successful psychologist.
Ksenia said: “I am a psychologist requesting, customers are planned two months in advance. My advice costs at least 40,000 rubles. I can lose more, because a trip to the product costs 30,000.
Bick refused to talk about her husband in the past. She believes that in history with his death, it is time to end.
Ksenia said everything was clear for a long time. The cause of his death was alcohol. And I made a very good job with my career. I had a group of customers for a long time, Ksenia said.
Remember that before the death of Dmitry Maryanov, with the insults of relatives, they sent Phoenix to the Lobne Rehabilitation Center. There, it became worse for the artist, but he was not provided with eligible support for a long time, and when they took the hospital, it was too late. Maryanov could not save.
